Name: Mute Chest and Door Sounds
Author: SAINPAI
Description:
This mod replaces the following sounds with silence:
[list]
[*][code]openChest[/code]
[*][code]doorCreak[/code]
[*][code]doorCreakReverse[/code]
[/list]🎯 [b]What it does:[/b]
Mutes the sound effects for opening chests and doors, useful if you find them repetitive or loud.
🔧 [b]Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley [b]1.6.0 (Fitgirl)[/b]
[*]SMAPI [b]4.0.6[/b]
[*]Content Patcher [b]2.0.6[/b]
[/list]📁 [b]Installation:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Extract the [code]MuteChestSound[/code] folder into your [code]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/code] directory.

[*]Launch the game via SMAPI.

[/list]📝 [b]Credits:[/b]
Made using Content Patcher. Silent sound ([code]silence.wav[/code]) generated manually.

Downloads.Description: Silences creaky door and chest sounds in Stardew Valley by replacing them with a silent audio file. Perfect for players who find the default sound effects jarring or repetitive. Compatible with SDV 1.6+ and SMAPI via Content Patcher.
